strings.aggregate_many: {count} people reported {depth} near {place} within the last hour.
strings.aggregate_none: No neighbourhood reports are available to show yet.
strings.aggregate_one: Aggregated reports do not appear until at least two people confirm the same water level nearby.
strings.assamese_pending: Assamese text is pending owner review. Showing reviewed English.
strings.hwm_eyebrow: RECALLED HISTORY · NEVER SHOWN AS LIVE
strings.hwm_intro: Only in the dry season: tell us how high the water came in a past flood at the spot you are standing on. This seeds future warnings and never mixes with live reports.
strings.hwm_reference_hint: e.g. up to the window sill
strings.no_recent_reading: No recent gauge reading is available.
strings.reciprocity_prompt: Help your neighbours — what's the water like where you are?
strings.report_eyebrow: ONE TAP · LOCATION ROUNDED TO 50 m
strings.report_geolocation_prompt: Tap to attach your location, rounded to about 50 m so your exact spot is never recorded.
strings.report_geolocation_unsupported: Location is unavailable on this device. Pick your circle in Settings instead.
strings.report_question: Water where you are right now?
strings.report_queued: Saved on this phone. It will sync when the network returns.
strings.report_quorum_note: A single report is never shown to others. Reports are grouped and shown only after enough neighbours confirm.
strings.report_sync_unconfigured: Kept locally. Sync endpoint is not configured yet.
